skills.name: haloskill-start
skills.title: Start
skills.description: Choose the next HaloSkill workflow from the brief, current artifacts, and project stage.
skills.output: Project state and next action
skills.command: $haloskill-start read this brief, identify the current stage, and route the next useful action.

skills.name: haloskill-project-setup
skills.title: Project Setup
skills.description: Turn a website brief into scope, owners, delivery tasks, decisions, risks, and ongoing project updates.
skills.output: Project brief, board, requirements and decision log
skills.command: $haloskill-project-setup turn this brief into a scoped delivery plan and maintain the project artifacts.

skills.name: haloskill-roadmap-to-timeline
skills.title: Roadmap to Timeline
skills.description: Convert an approved estimate into a working-day timeline with explicit assumptions and review windows.
skills.output: Schedule JSON, timeline table, optional Notion views
skills.command: $haloskill-roadmap-to-timeline convert this estimate into a dated timeline with explicit capacity and review assumptions.

skills.name: haloskill-workshop-client-research
skills.title: Workshop Client Research
skills.description: Prepare client and competitor research for the content strategy workshop.
skills.output: Workshop research packet
skills.command: $haloskill-workshop-client-research research this client and prepare evidence for the workshop.

skills.name: haloskill-workshop-script-writer
skills.title: Workshop Script Writer
skills.description: Prepare the facilitator script, questions, exercises, and timing for a people-led workshop.
skills.output: Facilitator script
skills.command: $haloskill-workshop-script-writer prepare a workshop script from the brief and client research.

skills.name: haloskill-research
skills.title: Research
skills.description: Synthesize evidence or investigate audience, competitors, and industry questions beyond workshop preparation.
skills.output: Evidence ledger, findings, implications and open questions
skills.command: $haloskill-research synthesize these sources into findings and design implications.

skills.name: haloskill-site-architecture
skills.title: Site Architecture
skills.description: Define a website sitemap, navigation, URLs, content responsibilities, and key user flows before visual design.
skills.output: Sitemap, page inventory, navigation and flows
skills.command: $haloskill-site-architecture create the sitemap and primary user flows from the approved brief.

skills.name: haloskill-concepts
skills.title: Concepts
skills.description: Create distinct visual directions and editable HTML concepts for a marketing website from an approved brief.
skills.output: Comparable visual directions and HTML concepts
skills.command: $haloskill-concepts create distinct website directions from the approved brief and sitemap.

skills.name: haloskill-copywriting
skills.title: Copywriting
skills.description: Write and edit website copy using approved positioning, brand voice, audience evidence, and verified proof.
skills.output: Page copy, CTA variants, metadata and content gaps
skills.command: $haloskill-copywriting write website copy from the approved sitemap, research, and brand voice.

skills.name: haloskill-presentations
skills.title: Presentations
skills.description: Prepare Halo proposals, concept presentations, and project review decks with evidence and clear client decisions.
skills.output: Editable deck, speaker notes and feedback log
skills.command: $haloskill-presentations prepare a concept presentation with rationale, tradeoffs, and a clear client decision.

skills.name: haloskill-web-build
skills.title: Web Build
skills.description: Implement approved website designs using the studio Next.js starter and its built-in component, motion, and QA workflows.
skills.output: Website implementation, Storybook and verification evidence
skills.command: $haloskill-web-build implement the approved design with the studio Next.js starter.

skills.name: haloskill-design-review
skills.title: Design Review
skills.description: Review a design against the brief, approved direction, content, and acceptance criteria and record actionable decisions.
skills.output: Review findings and approval decisions
skills.command: $haloskill-design-review review this design against the brief and agreed acceptance criteria.

skills.name: haloskill-handoff
skills.title: Handoff
skills.description: Prepare acceptance, launch readiness, and client handoff for a design-only or implemented website.
skills.output: Delivery package, acceptance matrix and ownership plan
skills.command: $haloskill-handoff prepare the final delivery package and acceptance checklist.

skills.name: haloskill-interface-design
skills.title: Interface Design
skills.description: Design product interfaces such as dashboards, admin tools, and account areas when the website includes application UI.
skills.output: Interface designs and interaction rules
skills.command: $haloskill-interface-design design the product interface using the approved context and workflows.

skills.name: haloskill-figma-library
skills.title: Figma Library
skills.description: Create or maintain editable Figma variables and components when a Figma design system is a deliverable.
skills.output: Figma variables, components and documentation
skills.command: $haloskill-figma-library build the Figma library from the approved tokens and components.

skills.name: haloskill-code-connect
skills.title: Code Connect
skills.description: Map existing Figma components to implementation components using the supported Code Connect integration.
skills.output: Validated mappings or template files
skills.command: $haloskill-code-connect connect these Figma components to their implementation.

skills.name: haloskill-design-debt
skills.title: Design Debt
skills.description: Inventory and prioritize accumulated design inconsistency in an existing website or product.
skills.output: Debt register with impact, effort and owners
skills.command: $haloskill-design-debt audit accumulated design inconsistencies and prioritize fixes.

skills.name: haloskill-imagegen
skills.title: Image Generation
skills.description: Generate or edit raster assets for a website through an available image generation provider.
skills.output: Generated assets and usage notes
skills.command: $haloskill-imagegen create the requested website image using the approved art direction.

skills.name: haloskill-brand-positioning
skills.title: Brand Positioning
skills.description: Clarify audience, category, differentiation, promise, and evidence when brand positioning is explicitly in scope.
skills.output: Positioning options and approved messaging foundation
skills.command: $haloskill-brand-positioning develop positioning options from audience and competitor evidence.

skills.name: haloskill-seo-audit
skills.title: SEO Audit
skills.description: Audit an existing or pre-launch website for technical and on-page SEO issues with evidence and prioritized fixes.
skills.output: SEO findings and verification plan
skills.command: $haloskill-seo-audit audit this website for technical and on-page SEO issues.

skills.name: haloskill-analytics
skills.title: Analytics
skills.description: Plan and verify website analytics events against business questions and actual implementation evidence.
skills.output: Measurement plan and event verification
skills.command: $haloskill-analytics define and verify analytics events for the primary website journeys.

skills.name: haloskill-design-canvas
skills.title: Design Canvas
skills.description: Use Design Canvas to review captured implemented pages, flows, and visual alternatives when its runtime is integrated.
skills.output: Captured page canvas, flows and review feedback
skills.command: $haloskill-design-canvas prepare a Design Canvas review of these implemented pages and flows.
